# SAMPLE RUNS — Polish bankruptcy, 1-year-ahead horizon (POLISH_1YR)

**Committee-facing acceptance pack (reviewed BEFORE the Go/No-Go decision).** Generated by `ml_models/score_acceptance_cases.py` from `polish_1yr.json` — reproducible, not one-off.

**Model:** AEGIS-approved WOE-logistic (25 features) · **Portfolio default rate:** 6.9% · PD floored at 0.03% (Basel CRE32.3).

> **Scope.** This pack reports only methodology/regulation-grounded outputs: calibrated PD, rating grade (risk tier, on the institution's internal master scale), exact WOE reason codes, and the governed completeness decision. The **accept / refer / decline lending decision is set by the institution applying its own risk-appetite PD threshold** — it is exogenous to this methodology and is **not** derived or priced here.

**Case composition (fixed standard):** 5 real applicants (drawn from the dataset, observed outcome shown — defaulted / repaid) + 3 synthetic composites (constructed from observed feature-value extremes; outcome shown is the construction intent, "(by design)", not an observed outcome — a PD-floor check and a stress check). Real cases span the risk range and include both outcomes.
